gen-gf-schoolbell-space-grotesk: Schoolbell looks scribbled in a relaxed hand, its e's left open. Space Grotesk answers with ribbon-like plain sans letters, geometric and hollow-centered, so the hand-drawn top stays loose while the lower text stays tidy.
gen-gf-sedgwick-ave-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans reads sharp and refined, with curves that stop well short of the stem. Sedgwick Ave brings a graceful, friendly handwritten warmth up top, while the sans below keeps everything crisp.
gen-gf-sedgwick-ave-fs-literata: Literata brings a bookish, sophisticated voice, with sturdy hairlines and wide-mouthed curves. Sedgwick Ave loosens the top with its friendly hand-drawn lines, and Literata then settles the page with its restful, modest swings in stroke weight.
gen-gf-shadows-into-light-two-fs-bespoke: Shadows Into Light Two looks jotted down, friendly and a little loose. Its casual handwriting suits quick, personable headings, while Bespoke Sans, a plain sans with generous room beside each stem, keeps the text sharp and refined.
gen-gf-shadows-into-light-two-fs-literat: Casual ink, openly drawn. Literata then steps in with a bookish text serif, its sturdy hairlines and mid-level stroke contrast giving the graceful handwriting above a more sophisticated footing.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-epunda-slab: Neon tubing bent into friendly, expressive letters, all at a constant thickness. And Epunda Slab, a dignified serif with a visibly gaping c and tall rounded lowercase, gives that glowing energy a classic counterweight.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-fauna-one: Fauna One reads literary and dignified, with a tall middle band and shallow ascenders. Across a longer passage it feels low-key and bookish, a quiet counterpart to the expressive tubing-like strokes of Shantell Sans.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-glegoo: Shantell Sans draws expressive, tube-like letters with a mouth wide as a cut tin lid. Glegoo follows with a refined, editorial serif whose big counters and tall lowercase make a taller, steadier counterpart.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-hanuman: Hanuman reads traditional and refined, a classic serif with a high-waisted lowercase and wide-set terminals on s. Shantell Sans sits above it with glassy neon-tube strokes, so the loud, distinctive heading meets a more restrained text.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-kadwa: Shantell Sans draws uninterrupted monoline strokes with a wide, open mouth. Kadwa, a classic serif with open-ended curves and a larger-than-usual x-height, would carry a longer passage with an editorial, easygoing flow.
